title: Quiz: How to Get Out of Tutorial Hell
description: Test how well you can turn Python tutorials into practical projects by specifying problems, weighing tradeoffs, and knowing when you're done.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of How to Get Out of Tutorial Hell . By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit why tutorials deliberately narrow a problem, which general skills they leave out, and how analyzing tutorials, writing your own, and building projects help you practice specifying problems, making tradeoffs, spotting gaps in your knowledge, and deciding when you’re done.
takeaways: By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit why tutorials deliberately narrow a problem, which general skills they leave out, and how analyzing tutorials, writing your own, and building projects help you practice specifying problems, making tradeoffs, spotting gaps in your knowledge, and deciding when you’re done.

When you’re ready to put these skills to work, pick something to build from 13 Project Ideas for Intermediate Python Developers .
